## Create a Sharp Cat Eye in Seconds

Get a defined winged look with the No Lie Cat Eye Waterproof Pen Eyeliner. Its double-sided design pairs an eye-specific stamp with a fine-tip pen, so you can set the wing first and then refine the rest of your lash line.

## Features That Shape Your Look

- **Winged stamp:** Line it up from the outer corner of your eye toward your brow for matching wings on each side.
- **Eye-specific designs:** Stamps are shaped for different eye forms, including hooded lids.
- **Deep pigment:** Well-inked stamps deliver a consistent shape with every application.
- **Fine-tip end:** Defines the rest of the lash line with precision, and you can build the line from thin to thick.
- **Smudge-proof, water-resistant formula:** Holds its shape through daily wear.
- **0.8 g, cruelty-free pen:** A compact size for your makeup bag.

## Benefits for Your Daily Routine

Stamping a wing takes the guesswork out of cat eye makeup, so you finish your look faster. The formula stays put through a rainy commute or an unplanned pool day, which lets you plan your day without worrying about touch-ups. If you have oily or combination lids, apply eyeshadow primer first to help your liner last longer.

## Gentle, Reliable Application

Shoppers often mention how smoothly the liner glides and how well it holds up through the day.
